goal: Complete the v1 backend: ingest PDF/docx/HTML/Markdown via background jobs, answer questions with source citations via hybrid retrieval + DeepSeek, and manage documents, with the full test suite green and docs in sync.

phases.name: Embeddings & vectors
phases.focus: Pinecone client, embedding, vector repo, reranker

phases.name: Hardening & docs
phases.focus: error semantics, limits, docs sync, final verification

tasks.name: Database schema and initialization
tasks.description: Define the SQLite schema (documents, chunks, jobs tables) plus an FTS5 virtual table over chunk text for BM25 keyword search. Provide async DB init/connect (aiosqlite) via app lifespan, driven by the configurable database path in settings. Init must be idempotent.
acceptance_criteria: documents table has id, name, format, size_bytes, status, error_message, created_at, updated_at
chunks table has id, doc_id, chunk_index, text, tokens; jobs table has id, document_id, stage, chunks_processed, chunks_total, error_message, created_at, updated_at
FTS5 index over chunk text supports BM25 match queries; chunk deletes remove matching FTS5 rows
init is idempotent (safe to run twice) and runs on app startup via lifespan
database path is configurable via settings (default data/engine.db)
tests cover schema shape and idempotency against a temp DB

tasks.name: Document repository
tasks.description: Async CRUD repository over the documents table: create (status=pending), list newest-first, get by id, update status/error_message, delete.
acceptance_criteria: create returns a document with status=pending and UTC timestamps
list returns documents newest-first; get returns None for unknown id
update transitions status and refreshes updated_at; supports setting error_message
delete removes the row
unit tests against a temp/in-memory DB

tasks.name: Chunk repository
tasks.description: Async repository for chunks: insert batches of chunks together with their FTS5 rows, count and list chunks for a document, delete all chunks (and FTS5 rows) for a document atomically.
acceptance_criteria: batch insert persists chunk rows and FTS5 rows in one transaction
count_by_document, list_by_document, and delete_by_document behave correctly
delete_by_document removes both chunk rows and FTS5 entries
unit tests against a temp DB

tasks.name: Job repository
tasks.description: Async repository for ingestion jobs: create, get by id, update stage, chunk counters, and error_message.
acceptance_criteria: create returns a job with initial stage and zeroed counters
get returns None for unknown id
update stage/counters/error_message and refresh updated_at
unit tests against a temp DB

tasks.name: BM25 search repository
tasks.description: Async FTS5 query wrapper: safe query construction (escaping), top-k retrieval ordered by BM25 rank, empty-result handling.
acceptance_criteria: search(text, k) returns chunk ids ordered by FTS5 bm25 rank
user-query punctuation/special characters cannot break or error the match query
no matches returns an empty list
unit tests against a temp DB with seeded chunks

tasks.name: Parser contract, registry, and Markdown parser
tasks.description: Define the parsed-document model (plain text plus structural blocks: headings with levels, paragraphs) and a registry dispatching by file extension. Implement the Markdown parser first as the reference implementation.
acceptance_criteria: ParsedDocument exposes both full text and structured blocks (heading level + paragraph text) sufficient for structure-aware chunking
registry maps .md to the markdown parser; unknown extensions are rejected
markdown parser preserves ATX/setext headings as structure and strips markup from text
unit tests with .md fixtures

tasks.name: HTML parser
tasks.description: Extract headings (h1–h6) as structural blocks and paragraph text from HTML; strip scripts, styles, navigation, and tags; register .html/.htm.
acceptance_criteria: headings map to structural blocks with correct levels
script/style/nav content is excluded from extracted text
registry resolves .html and .htm
unit tests with .html fixtures

tasks.name: docx parser
tasks.description: Extract paragraphs and heading blocks from .docx (via paragraph styles/outline levels), preserving tables as readable text; register .docx.
acceptance_criteria: heading paragraphs (Heading 1–6 styles) become structural blocks
body paragraphs become text blocks in order; tables are flattened to readable text
registry resolves .docx
unit tests with generated .docx fixtures

tasks.name: PDF parser
tasks.description: Extract text from .pdf page by page, preserving paragraph structure as best the library allows; surface unreadable/corrupt PDFs as parse failures; register .pdf.
acceptance_criteria: text is extracted in page order and grouped into paragraphs
corrupt/unreadable PDFs raise a typed parse error that the job layer maps to status=failed with no retry
registry resolves .pdf
unit tests with generated PDF fixtures (simple + corrupt)

tasks.name: Structure-aware chunker
tasks.description: Chunk parsed documents on structure (headings/paragraphs) first, then cap size: target ~500 tokens with ~50-token overlap; never split a sentence (last-resort split only for pathological unbroken blocks). Deterministic chunk ids from doc_id + index.
acceptance_criteria: chunks respect heading/paragraph boundaries rather than fixed-size cuts
target ~500 tokens per chunk with ~50-token overlap between adjacent chunks
no sentence is split unless the block is an unbroken multi-thousand-token run
chunk ids are deterministic: same doc_id + input produce identical ids
unit tests cover structure preservation, sentence integrity, overlap, and determinism

tasks.name: Pinecone client wrapper
tasks.description: Thin wrapper over the pinecone SDK connecting to the pre-created index named by PINECONE_INDEX, providing the index handle used by the embedding, vector, and reranker services. Errors surface clearly when the index/key are missing.
acceptance_criteria: client connects using settings (PINECONE_INDEX, PINECONE_API_KEY) without hardcoding
missing index/key produces a clear, typed error message
no live API calls in tests — all Pinecone usage is mocked
unit tests using mocked SDK

tasks.name: Embedding service
tasks.description: Wrap Pinecone inference /embed (llama-text-embed-v2, 1024-dim): batch inputs (≤32, sequential), input_type=passage for documents and query for questions, transient-error retries.
acceptance_criteria: embed(list[str], input_type) returns one 1024-dim vector per input
passage/query input_type is set correctly per caller
batches are ≤32 and processed sequentially; results preserve input order
transient errors are retried per retry policy
unit tests with mocked inference API

tasks.name: Vector repository
tasks.description: Async wrapper over Pinecone index operations: upsert vectors (batch ~100) carrying chunk id + doc_id metadata, query top-k with scores, delete all vectors for a document via the doc_id metadata filter.
acceptance_criteria: upsert writes vectors with ids equal to chunk ids and doc_id metadata
query(text_vector, k) returns matches with scores
delete_by_document(doc_id) removes all matching vectors via the metadata filter
unit tests with a mocked index

tasks.name: Reranker service
tasks.description: Wrap Pinecone hosted inference /rerank (bge-reranker-v2-m3): rerank a candidate list for a query, top_n output, rank_fields=["text"], and truncate=END to avoid the model's NONE-truncation error on long chunks.
acceptance_criteria: rerank(query, docs, top_n=3) returns scored results (0–1) in rank order
truncate=END and rank_fields=["text"] are always sent
unit tests with a mocked rerank API

tasks.name: Ingestion job worker and executor
tasks.description: Thread-pool worker that executes a job through parse → chunk → embed → index, updating stage and chunk counters along the way. On completion marks the document indexed and job succeeded; parse failures fail fast with an error_message.
acceptance_criteria: runs jobs on a bounded in-process thread pool (no external queue)
executes the full pipeline and updates document status to indexed and job to succeeded
stage and chunks_processed/total progress are persisted as work proceeds
parse failure marks job failed with a clear error_message and no retry
transient embed/upsert failures trigger the retry policy before failing
integration-style tests with all hosted calls mocked

tasks.name: Retry with exponential backoff
tasks.description: Shared retry helper for transient hosted-API errors (embed, upsert, rerank, chat): up to 3 attempts with exponential backoff (1s → 4s → 16s), then propagate the final error. Parse errors are never retried.
acceptance_criteria: transient errors are retried up to 3 times with the specified backoff
a call that fails transiently then succeeds returns the success (job completes)
an always-failing call surfaces the final error so the job/query fails with a clear message
parse errors are excluded from retry
unit tests with mocks that fail a configurable number of times

tasks.name: Retrieval orchestrator (vector + BM25 + RRF + rerank)
tasks.description: Orchestrate a query: embed the question (input_type=query) → Pinecone top-10 → FTS5 BM25 top-10 → RRF fusion (k=60) to top-20 → hosted rerank to top-3. Empty candidate set short-circuits before rerank/LLM.
acceptance_criteria: returns the top 3 reranked chunks with scores in rank order
RRF uses k=60 over the union of vector and BM25 candidates
empty retrieval returns an empty result without calling rerank
integration-style tests with mocked embed/query/rerank

tasks.name: DeepSeek chat client
tasks.description: Wrap the OpenAI SDK for DeepSeek chat completions: base URL and model (deepseek-v4-flash) from settings, non-thinking mode, returns the answer text, and maps quota/network errors to typed exceptions.
acceptance_criteria: calls chat completions with the configured model and non-thinking mode
returns the assistant message text
quota/rate-limit and network errors raise typed exceptions
unit tests with a mocked OpenAI client

tasks.name: Answer orchestration and prompt
tasks.description: Assemble the query answer: build the system prompt (answer from provided chunks only, no invented citations, say so when absent), feed the top-3 chunks + question to DeepSeek, and return the answer plus structured sources (chunk_id, doc_id, doc_name, excerpt, score). Empty retrieval returns the canned 'no sources' message without calling the LLM.
acceptance_criteria: prompt instructs grounded answering and no invented citations
response contains answer text and sources for the top-3 chunks
empty retrieval returns the canned no-sources message with empty sources and no LLM call
unit tests with mocked chat

tasks.name: Document upload endpoint
tasks.description: POST /documents: accept a multipart file (.pdf/.docx/.html/.md), validate extension and size, store the original at data/uploads/<doc_id><ext>, create document + job rows, enqueue the background job, respond 202 with document + job.
acceptance_criteria: 202 returns the pending document and job per docs/endpoints.md
unsupported extension or empty file returns 400
file over the size limit (50 MB default, configurable) returns 413
original is saved to data/uploads/<doc_id><ext>
endpoint tests with uploads and job execution mocked

tasks.name: Document list and detail endpoints
tasks.description: GET /documents (list newest-first with status) and GET /documents/{id} (detail plus chunk_count and error_message).
acceptance_criteria: list returns all documents newest-first per the contract
detail returns chunk_count (0 when not indexed) and error_message on failure
detail returns 404 for unknown ids
endpoint tests

tasks.name: Document delete endpoint
tasks.description: DELETE /documents/{id}: delete Pinecone vectors by doc_id metadata filter, then chunk + FTS5 + document rows in SQLite, then the stored original file. Returns 204; 404 for unknown ids.
acceptance_criteria: deletes vectors, SQLite rows (chunks + FTS5 + document), and the original file
returns 204 on success and 404 for unknown ids
endpoint tests with Pinecone delete mocked

tasks.name: Document re-index endpoint
tasks.description: POST /documents/{id}/reindex: clear old vectors via metadata filter, reset status to pending, enqueue a fresh job against the stored original (no re-upload), respond 202 with the new job.
acceptance_criteria: old vectors are cleared and status reset to pending
a fresh job runs the pipeline on the stored original; 202 returns the job
404 for unknown ids
endpoint tests with Pinecone + job execution mocked

tasks.name: Job status endpoint
tasks.description: GET /jobs/{id}: return stage, chunks_processed, chunks_total, error_message. 404 for unknown ids.
acceptance_criteria: returns the job payload per docs/endpoints.md
404 for unknown ids
endpoint tests

tasks.name: Query endpoint
tasks.description: POST /queries: synchronous — embed question, retrieve, rerank, generate answer, return answer + sources. Empty retrieval returns the canned no-sources message; missing/empty question returns 400; hosted-service failure returns 503 with a retryable message.
acceptance_criteria: 200 with answer + top-3 sources per docs/endpoints.md
no sources found returns the canned message with empty sources (no LLM call)
missing/empty question returns 400
hosted-service unavailability returns 503 with a retryable detail
endpoint tests with all hosted calls mocked

tasks.name: Hardening and error-semantics audit
tasks.description: Audit the whole API against docs/endpoints.md: consistent {detail} error shape, correct 400/404/413/503 codes, configurable upload size limit, safe file handling, and quota errors surfaced as failed jobs with clear messages.
acceptance_criteria: every endpoint matches its documented status codes and response shapes
upload size limit is configurable via settings and enforced
quota-exceeded errors fail jobs with a clear message
no secrets/logs of keys anywhere in the codebase
full test suite passes

tasks.name: Docs sync and final verification
tasks.description: Reconcile docs with code: chunking numbers, top-k, retries, model name, error semantics. Update docs/rag-workflow.md, docs/endpoints.md, docs/architecture.md, README.md, and docs/risks-and-open-questions.md. Run the full verification gate.
acceptance_criteria: no stale TBDs or contradictions between docs and code
README reflects what the backend actually does
pytest passes with only mocked hosted calls; ruff check and format are clean
a manual local smoke run (real keys) confirms upload → job → query round trip
